c74object.name: mc.ear.record~
c74object.digest: Record an ADM file (BW64 with ADM metadata): the multichannel input carries the tracks in file order, the objects' audio first (one channel per object, as fed to mc.ear.objects~), then a DirectSpeakers bed (directchans) and an HOA scene (hoaorder), combined with mc.combine~
c74object.description: Record an ADM file (BW64 with ADM metadata): the multichannel input carries the tracks in file order, the objects' audio first (one channel per object, as fed to mc.ear.objects~), then a DirectSpeakers bed (directchans) and an HOA scene (hoaorder), combined with mc.combine~. The object metadata is sent to this object in the same format as to mc.ear.objects~ (setvalue N parameter, applyvalues, lists) while it records: every change is written as an audioBlockFormat timed by the audio itself, with the ramp in force as its interpolation, so audio and metadata cannot drift apart. The bed and scene metadata is static, given as 'direct ...' and 'hoa ...' messages in the formats of mc.ear.direct~ and mc.ear.hoa~. 'open path' names the file, 'start' (or 1) records from the current parameters, 'stop' (or 0) finishes the file and reports it on the outlet. Extra input channels are ignored, missing ones are silent. Files over 4 GB are written as RF64.

method.name: anything
method.digest: Object metadata: any parameter sent as a message applies to all objects
method.description: Object metadata: any parameter sent as a message applies to all objects.

method.name: applyvalues
method.digest: Object metadata: 'applyvalues parameter v1 v2 v3 ...' spreads values over the objects
method.description: Object metadata: 'applyvalues parameter v1 v2 v3 ...' spreads values over the objects.

method.name: bitdepth
method.digest: Set the bitdepth attribute
method.description: Set the bitdepth attribute. Bit depth of the audio written: 16, 24 or 32 (integer PCM). Takes effect at the next 'start'.

method.name: chans
method.digest: Set the chans attribute
method.description: Set the chans attribute. Number of objects recorded: the first channels of the file, one per input channel (extra input channels are ignored, missing ones are silent). Takes effect at the next 'start'.

method.name: clear
method.digest: Reset every object's parameters and ramp and the bed channels' parameters (not while recording)
method.description: Reset every object's parameters and ramp and the bed channels' parameters (not while recording).

method.name: direct
method.digest: Metadata of the bed recorded after the objects (see the directchans attribute), in the mc.ear.direct~ format: 'direct setvalue N speakerlabel M+030' (N is 1-based; 0 sets all channels), 'direct setvalue N position az el [dist]', azimuth, elevation, distance, cartesian (then position is x y z), x, y, z, bounds, lfe, packformat, 'direct applyvalues parameter v1 v2 ...', 'direct inputlayout 0+5+0' (labels, positions and LFE after a BS.2051 layout, written as a reference to the common definitions when the layout has one), 'direct name symbol' (the bed's audioObject name), or 'direct parameter values' for all channels
method.description: Metadata of the bed recorded after the objects (see the directchans attribute), in the mc.ear.direct~ format: 'direct setvalue N speakerlabel M+030' (N is 1-based; 0 sets all channels), 'direct setvalue N position az el [dist]', azimuth, elevation, distance, cartesian (then position is x y z), x, y, z, bounds, lfe, packformat, 'direct applyvalues parameter v1 v2 ...', 'direct inputlayout 0+5+0' (labels, positions and LFE after a BS.2051 layout, written as a reference to the common definitions when the layout has one), 'direct name symbol' (the bed's audioObject name), or 'direct parameter values' for all channels. The 'tracks' message of ear.adm or mc.ear.play~ is ignored, so their direct outlet can be fed to this message. While recording, a change of a channel's labels, position or bounds is written as a timed block at the audio's current time (such a bed gets its own channel formats); lfe and packformat are the channel's for the whole file.

method.name: directchans
method.digest: Set the directchans attribute
method.description: Set the directchans attribute. Number of DirectSpeakers channels recorded as a bed on the input channels after the objects (0: no bed); their metadata comes from 'direct' messages. Takes effect at the next 'start'.

method.name: float
method.digest: 1 starts recording, 0 stops (as mc.sfrecord~)
method.description: 1 starts recording, 0 stops (as mc.sfrecord~).

method.name: hoa
method.digest: Metadata of the HOA scene recorded after the bed, in the mc.ear.hoa~ format: 'hoa order N' (the hoaorder attribute; -1 for no scene), 'hoa normalization SN3D|N3D|FuMa' and 'hoa name symbol'
method.description: Metadata of the HOA scene recorded after the bed, in the mc.ear.hoa~ format: 'hoa order N' (the hoaorder attribute; -1 for no scene), 'hoa normalization SN3D|N3D|FuMa' and 'hoa name symbol'. The 'tracks' message of ear.adm or mc.ear.play~ is ignored, so their hoa outlet can be fed to this message.

method.name: hoanormalization
method.digest: Set the hoanormalization attribute
method.description: Set the hoanormalization attribute. Normalization of the HOA scene recorded: SN3D, N3D or FuMa. Also set by 'hoa normalization name'.

method.name: hoaorder
method.digest: Set the hoaorder attribute
method.description: Set the hoaorder attribute. Ambisonic order of the HOA scene recorded on the (order+1)^2 input channels after the bed, in ACN order; -1 for no scene. Also set by 'hoa order N'. Takes effect at the next 'start'.

method.name: list
method.digest: Object metadata: a list sets the position of all objects
method.description: Object metadata: a list sets the position of all objects.

method.name: name
method.digest: Name an object in the file: 'name N symbol' (N is 1-based)
method.description: Name an object in the file: 'name N symbol' (N is 1-based).

method.name: open
method.digest: Name the file to record: 'open path' (an absolute path, or relative to the Max search path)
method.description: Name the file to record: 'open path' (an absolute path, or relative to the Max search path).

method.name: position
method.digest: Report the recording's length so far in milliseconds on the outlet
method.description: Report the recording's length so far in milliseconds on the outlet.

method.name: programmename
method.digest: Set the programmename attribute
method.description: Set the programmename attribute. Name of the audioProgramme written.

method.name: ramp
method.digest: Set the ramp attribute
method.description: Set the ramp attribute. Default interpolation time in milliseconds written for the changes, as the renderer's ramp attribute; 'setvalue N ramp ms' overrides it per object (a negative value returns to it).

method.name: setvalue
method.digest: Object metadata, in the mc.ear.objects~ format: 'setvalue N parameter values...' (N is 1-based; 0 sets all objects)
method.description: Object metadata, in the mc.ear.objects~ format: 'setvalue N parameter values...' (N is 1-based; 0 sets all objects). Parameters: azimuth elevation distance x y z cartesian position width height depth gain diffuse channellock channellock_distance divergence divergence_range screenref screenedgelock_h screenedgelock_v, and ramp (the interpolation time written for the next changes of that object; negative returns to the ramp attribute). While recording, a change becomes a block at the audio's current time.

method.name: start
method.digest: Start recording the file named by 'open' (or 'start path'): the audio is written from now, the objects' current parameters become their first blocks
method.description: Start recording the file named by 'open' (or 'start path'): the audio is written from now, the objects' current parameters become their first blocks. Reports 'recording path' on the outlet.

method.name: stop
method.digest: Stop recording: the file is finished with the captured metadata and reported as 'written path tracks length-ms' on the outlet (or 'failed path')
method.description: Stop recording: the file is finished with the captured metadata and reported as 'written path tracks length-ms' on the outlet (or 'failed path').

attribute.name: bitdepth
attribute.digest: Bit depth of the audio written: 16, 24 or 32 (integer PCM)
attribute.description: Bit depth of the audio written: 16, 24 or 32 (integer PCM). Takes effect at the next 'start'. Default: 24.

attribute.name: chans
attribute.digest: Number of objects recorded: the first channels of the file, one per input channel (extra input channels are ignored, missing ones are silent)
attribute.description: Number of objects recorded: the first channels of the file, one per input channel (extra input channels are ignored, missing ones are silent). Takes effect at the next 'start'. Default: 16.

attribute.name: directchans
attribute.digest: Number of DirectSpeakers channels recorded as a bed on the input channels after the objects (0: no bed); their metadata comes from 'direct' messages
attribute.description: Number of DirectSpeakers channels recorded as a bed on the input channels after the objects (0: no bed); their metadata comes from 'direct' messages. Takes effect at the next 'start'. Default: 0.

attribute.name: hoanormalization
attribute.digest: Normalization of the HOA scene recorded: SN3D, N3D or FuMa
attribute.description: Normalization of the HOA scene recorded: SN3D, N3D or FuMa. Also set by 'hoa normalization name'. Default: SN3D.

attribute.name: hoaorder
attribute.digest: Ambisonic order of the HOA scene recorded on the (order+1)^2 input channels after the bed, in ACN order; -1 for no scene
attribute.description: Ambisonic order of the HOA scene recorded on the (order+1)^2 input channels after the bed, in ACN order; -1 for no scene. Also set by 'hoa order N'. Takes effect at the next 'start'. Default: -1.

attribute.name: programmename
attribute.description: Name of the audioProgramme written. Default: libear-max.

attribute.name: ramp
attribute.digest: Default interpolation time in milliseconds written for the changes, as the renderer's ramp attribute; 'setvalue N ramp ms' overrides it per object (a negative value returns to it)
attribute.description: Default interpolation time in milliseconds written for the changes, as the renderer's ramp attribute; 'setvalue N ramp ms' overrides it per object (a negative value returns to it). Default: 10.
